basis.decisions: DECIDED by the owner on 2026-10-22 (not proposals): the freeze-gate package for the Shakti draft specs carried Spec 072's open items OPEN-072-1 to OPEN-072-10 to the freeze with the owner's rulings - the verdict line derived at the freeze by the draft's fixed rule and recorded with its reference record, or the freeze fails as VERDICT LINE NOT DERIVABLE with no fallback line (OPEN-072-1); the concordance per the draft, every member's ICIT identity stated and pinned on the stated basis, any unidentified member named UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT with its disposition ruled in the freeze record (OPEN-072-2); the Roif gate confirmed in its drafted form (OPEN-072-10); all other items ruled per the draft's stated defaults; the execution phase allocated as Phase-431 (OPEN-072-8). The freeze record (freeze.md sections 2-6) carries each ruling and the freeze-stage step-0 exhibits.

claim_under_test.record: The fish sign (meen in Dravidian) is the primary rebus sign in the Indus script - standing IN QUESTION, partially supported: Mahadevan sign 72 passed its Phase-43 T2.4 positional test; sign 267, the family's most frequent member, failed it clearly. That standing is Spec 048's record and this spec's starting point; this spec does not re-derive it and does not inherit Spec 048's calibration.

basis.considered_not_governing: data/crosswalks/sign_crosswalk_master.csv (sha256 4ace1a617f40afe8d0bbb82e5461d98a675296152e7577b04fb67b00f4f5dfcf) carries no Wells/ICIT code; the curated Mahadevan-Parpola crosswalk's wells_id values for this family (W008-W042) appear in neither basis file and are absent or near-absent in the pinned corpus

concordance.disposition: DD-072-5 confirmed: each unidentified member is named UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT in the headline block, excluded from both populations' weighting, never dropped silently and never substituted; its occurrence share in ICIT space cannot be measured and is reported as such
concordance.divergence_named: the registry's depiction notes for P145 and P147 (stroke signs) and for P047 (a decorated vertical line) differ from Asset F's depiction notes for the same Parpola numbers; the concordance is a numbering concordance on the stated basis, membership remains Asset F's exactly as frozen, and the divergence is reported in freeze.md section 4 and in every execution headline block
concordance.ruling: OPEN-072-2: governing basis confirmed as two held files, each pinned by SHA-256; the member's ICIT identity, keyed by its Parpola number, is the unique code in the intersection of the registry row's wells_ids and the glyph ids of the crosswalk's confirmed rows whose best_parpola_match is that Parpola number; an intersection not holding exactly one code names the member UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT

design.execution_gate: execution (Phase-431) runs after this freeze has merged and the OSF contract registration is filed, under the execution order given in the same owner tasking that commissioned this freeze; the registration's approval act remains the owner's click and is not performed by the freeze or the execution
design.freeze_does_not: the freeze does not itself score any member (no member ending-follower fraction exists at the freeze, in either population); it does not settle the depiction divergence named in the concordance; it re-opens nothing in Spec 044's asset, Spec 048's closure, or the Phase-43 record; it establishes nothing about what any fish sign meant or was pronounced
design.grade_flip: OPEN-072-6, DD-072-6 confirmed: a member whose carried supported label or PASS word changes between the populations is reported as a grade-flip finding in the outcome record's first section and the headline block; if the family word differs between populations the headline is the primary population's verdict flagged GRADE-SENSITIVE, both verdicts reported
design.measure: the T2.4 analogue of spec section 5.2, method carried from Amendment Queue Item 2 and labelled carried: positional classes per population under the carried cascade (classification floor total >= 5; t_rate >= 0.60 TERMINAL_STRONG; i_rate >= 0.55 INITIAL_STRONG; m_rate >= 0.65 MEDIAL_STRONG; t_rate >= 0.40 TERMINAL_MODERATE; i_rate >= 0.40 INITIAL_MODERATE; otherwise MIXED); a member's ending-follower fraction is the share of bigrams whose first sign is the member whose second sign is TERMINAL_STRONG or TERMINAL_MODERATE on the same population; carried floors: scanned iff total >= 10, the carried descriptive label supported iff fraction > 0.15 and total >= 20 (a descriptive label carried with the method, never this spec's verdict); no chance-baseline step is added (OPEN-072-4)
design.partition: OPEN-072-5, DD-072-2 confirmed: over the tested members (identified at gate 0.3, clearing the carried supported floor in the primary population), the passing members' token-weighted share w of the tested members' primary occurrences decides - w above 50 percent FAMILY SUPPORTED; w below 50 percent FAMILY NOT SUPPORTED; w exactly 50 percent, or the coverage condition (members UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT excepted as unmeasurable, identified members NOT SCANNED or SCANNED - BELOW SUPPORTED FLOOR together carrying more of the identified family's primary occurrences than the tested members), INCONCLUSIVE. Spec 048's 70 percent / 30 percent family lines are not carried
design.populations: primary: documented-lineage rows only (3,212 rows, 3,045 analyzable); sensitivity (mandatory): documented-lineage + undocumented-corroborated rows (5,299 rows, 5,131 analyzable), the whole test recomputed against the same L; undocumented-uncorroborated rows (405) enter no count; rows entirely 000 enter no sign analysis; sequences counted as stored, in stored order, no direction normalisation, with the 000 placeholder gated out before any position or bigram is counted (OPEN-072-3)
design.roif_gate: OPEN-072-10 confirmed in its drafted form (spec section 7 limit 1; claim F072-C14): no publication of this spec's results in any form without both (i) citation of Roif 2025a (Academia.edu doc 129921039) and Roif 2025b (Academia.edu doc 143222807) and (ii) the owner's clearance of the specific act, regardless of outcome; the gate constrains publication, not execution; records under this spec are internal until both conditions are met
design.step0_gates: in frozen order, re-asserted at execution step 0 before any member is scored: 0.1 Shakti intake assertion (P-F1 S1/S2 against the merged intake record; failure closes SHAKTI INTAKE NOT REPRODUCED) - PASS at the freeze; 0.2 Asset F digest assertion under Spec 044 section 4.2's exclusion rule (ASSET F NOT AVAILABLE / ASSET F DIGEST MISMATCH) - PASS at the freeze; 0.3 the concordance act (freeze.md section 4; CONCORDANCE FAILED if no member can be identified) - performed at the freeze, five identified, two UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT; 0.4 positional classes and census, margins only (TOO THIN if no identified member clears the supported floor in the primary population) - four testable at the freeze; 0.5 verdict-line assertion (the freeze-fixed L of this record; INVALID if none exists) - L = 0.765 derived and recorded at the freeze

verdict_line.degeneracy_rule: a reference population of fewer than 30 signs, or a 95th percentile of 0 or 1, fails the freeze as VERDICT LINE NOT DERIVABLE, with no fallback line; neither condition fired (86 signs; percentile 0.7647)
verdict_line.excluded_inputs: the Phase-43 reference points (25.9 percent for sign 72; 3.8 percent for sign 267) and Spec 048's 20 percent member bar are not inputs to this line in any form; the carried 0.15 supported label is not the line
verdict_line.pass_rule: a member PASSES iff its primary-population ending-follower fraction is at or above L and it clears the carried supported floor (total >= 20)
verdict_line.rule: spec section 5.3, applied at the freeze (OPEN-072-1): L is the 95th percentile, nearest-rank, of the freeze-stage reference distribution of non-fish signs clearing the carried supported floor (total >= 20) on the primary (documented-lineage) population, measured from non-members only, before any member was scored, stated to three decimal places rounding the percentile value up at the fourth decimal place
